## Verdict on this family: WIN by the definition the composite carries

The beyond-MP2 increment of the curvature, DZ → TZ, is +1.2 cm⁻¹ at naphthalene against benzene's registered +1.0 cm⁻¹ for the C–H
in-plane bend family: a difference of 0.2 cm⁻¹, inside the 2.5 cm⁻¹ win margin, same sign. The mixed form of 15 September
(k(LNO-CC) − k(full MP2)) gives +6.5 cm⁻¹ and would lose by 5.5 cm⁻¹ — but that form does not measure the physics the deck carries: its
DZ → TZ change is the growth of the LNO-MP2 truncation of the MP2 correlation (full MP2 − LNO-MP2 = 8 µE_h/q² at DZ, 57 at TZ), which
the composite removes by construction (SCF + LNO-CC − LNO-MP2 + full MP2). The composite definition is therefore the one the verdict
rests on; the mixed form is kept in the table as the 15 September reading required.

Everything about this family is well-behaved where the out-of-plane family was not: the quartic share c₄/k of the correlation part is
0.1 % at DZ (12 % for mode 12), the correlation curvature is one tenth of mode 12's, and the DZ → TZ change of the composite
frequency (−21 cm⁻¹, 1053 → 1032) is almost entirely SCF (−13.5) and MP2 (−8.4), both computed cheaply at any basis by decision 33.
